sw19-s5.headline: Human Written
windows: That works out to about one-sixteenth of the grown-ups per child that our brains evolved with (Perry, 2023). So the emptiness you feel (the "Void") is real, since it's what that missing company feels like.
Once you've de-armored, going back to a lonely life will tend to feel worse than it did with the armor on.
Gather a tribe of people you're close to and see most days, or you'll eventually reach for the armor again just to get through the loneliness.
